This should test the render cpp script.

```cpp
extern void render_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h);

int main() {
  render_rect(0,0,50,50);
  return 0;
}
```

Now we display a canvas with a square

```{=html}
<canvas id="wasmCanvas" width=400 heigh=400 style="background: black"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('wasmCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = 'red'; 
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 50, 50);
</script>
```
